decks.notes: This deck aims to disrupt and control opponents with efficient removal spells and disruption while applying pressure with evasive creatures. By using cards like Brazen Borrower and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt opponent's plans and force them to play on the back foot, combined with aggressive creatures like Troll of Khazad-dûm, the deck can push for a quick victory. Reanimate and Animate Dead provide additional utility and value by recurring threats or disrupting opponent's graveyard strategies. Overall, this deck aims to win quickly by disrupting opponent's game plan while applying relentless pressure.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly get a powerful creature into the graveyard using cards like Entomb and Grief, then use reanimation spells like Animate Dead and Reanimate to bring it back onto the battlefield. The deck also has counter spells like Force of Will and Daze to protect its combo pieces, along with card advantage with Brainstorm and Ponder. With a mix of disruptive creatures like Archon of Cruelty and efficient threats like Atraxa, Grand Unifier, the deck aims to control the game while setting up its combo win condition.

With efficient card draw spells like Brainstorm and Ponder, as well as countermagic in the form of Daze and Force of Will, this deck aims to create a dominant board presence and outpace the opponent's removal and disruption.

Overall, the deck focuses on explosive plays and quick wins through its combo potential.
